Container.Name: burner-matrix
Container.Overview: Internal field-sales burner selection matrix for Beckett and Wayne (incl. Comet) oil and gas burners, with a sign-in admin screen at /admin for editing burners. Burner data, uploaded photos, users and change history live in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Burner list, uploaded photos, users and change history. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: First admin username
Config.Description: Creates the first admin the first time the container starts. Add more people later in /admin.

Config.Name: First admin password
Config.Description: 8+ characters. Only used once, to create the first admin. Change it afterwards in /admin.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Set true if you only open it over https://

Config.Name: Behind reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set true behind Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG or a Cloudflare tunnel.
